form.label: Maps+ probe - assets, drilldown, click tokens (MP-05, MP-07)
form.description: Probe harness, classic. Panels E, F, G with token readouts. Same SPL and options as test/studio/probe2.json. See test/README.md.

search.query: | makeresults count=2 | streamstats count as n | eval latitude=34.05+n*0.01, longitude=-118.25, markerType="png", customIcon="marker-icon.png", tooltip="custom ".n | table latitude longitude markerType customIcon tooltip

panel.title: F - marker click sets token picked from row.picked (MP-07)

search.query: | makeresults count=2 | streamstats count as n | eval latitude=34.05+n*0.01, longitude=-118.25, picked=if(n=1,"area1","area2"), tooltip="Click: ".picked, markerType="circle" | table latitude longitude picked tooltip markerType

panel.title: F readout (expect: none until a marker is clicked)

search.query: | makeresults count=3 | streamstats count as n | eval latitude=34.05+n*0.01, longitude=-118.25, clickedLatLng=latitude.",".longitude, tooltip="G ".n | table latitude longitude clickedLatLng tooltip

panel.title: G readout (classic sets $clickedLatLng$ directly from a map click)
